images.author: Rémih
images.why: 4608 × 3456; documented Italian-side view from Mont de la Saxe above Courmayeur, a classic Mont Blanc viewpoint. Ample resolution for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Fulvio Spada
images.why: 5050 × 3456; Italian-side photograph taken on the trail from Pila towards Col de Chamolé. High-resolution alternative with a more distant mountain perspective.

images.author: Franco Simone Baldi Dolfi
images.why: 5882 × 3921; photograph of Mont Blanc's glacial landscape, catalogued under Courmayeur. Substantial cropping latitude for the poster format.

images.author: Ximonic (Simo Räsänen)
images.why: 3600 × 2400; classic Swiss-side view from Gornergrat, explicitly identifying Dufourspitze and the Monte Rosa Glacier. Strong first-choice composition for mountain recognition.

images.author: marco167
images.why: 2667 × 2000; close mountain-level view of Dufourspitze from neighbouring Nordend. Useful alternative when the summit itself should dominate the card.

images.author: Paweł Kuźniar
images.why: 2866 × 1911; the photographer explicitly identifies Dufourspitze as the highest peak in the centre, making it a straightforward candidate for a centred 9:10 crop.

images.author: Florian Fell
images.why: 3648 × 2736; documented photograph of Ras Dashen's summit formation, providing a specific summit subject rather than a generic Simien Mountains landscape.

images.author: Florian Fell
images.why: 2736 × 3648 portrait; shows Ras Dashen's western peak with small snow remnants. Convenient crop geometry, although this is the western subsidiary peak.

images.author: Nomadtales
images.why: Recognisable Mount Wilhelm photograph widely used to illustrate the mountain. Resolution fallback: the original is only 1600 × 1200, below the preferred 2000-pixel long side.

images.author: Jon Evans
images.why: Documented Mount Wilhelm summit photograph with a verified permissive licence. Resolution fallback: only 1544 × 1011, limiting a tight 9:10 crop.
